posts.post: walking into a high-end store and being ignored by the staff is the best way to shop.
the guy who owns five versions of the same gray sweater. he’s not boring, he just solved the problem.
why does every dressing room mirror make you look like you’ve never seen a gym in your life?

spent the morning debating if an internal seam should be taped. 

nobody sees it, but the friction difference is real.
